children: was gaining after the hospital REIT
a sale of Idaho Falls Community Hospital and Mountain View Hospital.
The sale was made to affiliates of Intermountain Health for $413M, representing a 6.9% capitalization rate.
Shares were 7.67% higher at $3.65 during morning trading on Thursday.
MPT gets $371M in cash proceeds, with the remaining $42M distributed to certain minority real estate owners.
The hospital REIT had invested ~$240M in the properties.
The transaction brings the company's aggregate cash proceeds to ~$680M during the third quarter. Majority of the proceeds are expected to be used to reduce debt.
